S0a.what: W0, zero-step control (stage 0, first, alone): a fine-tune of the plain 67M at zero steps against the 67M, on the read half
S0a.expected: gap 0 and max TV 0, at or under the float floor between two batch sizes (E148 read 1.13e-5), under floor_gap: no reading
S0a.rule: stop if max TV > floor or mean gap >= floor_gap

S0b.what: capacity read of E148's XOR2 label on its held-out key pairs from E148's saved plain seed-0 fine-tune (experiments/built_control/results/large/plain_s0.pt: 300 steps toward the full push, alpha 6), best of in1, in2, in3, out3; E148's 128 keys are rebuilt and checked against its stage1.json
S0b.expected: open, between E148's taught original read 0.588 (a third of the push) and 1. At or above linear_bar: a full-push fine-tune makes an XOR-type variable linearly readable; under it: the fine-tune computes XOR2 (learned ratio 0.15) without a linear trace, and the taught gate below is likely to miss
S0b.rule: reported either way; not a stop (a key mismatch is a stop)

S0c.what: on the plain 67M, keyed windows of the number task, held-out pairs, ridge from z_M at the last position at each of in1, in2, in3, out3: parity of a (second-to-last), parity of b (last), parity of a + b
S0c.expected: b near 1.0 (a function of the last token, 100 numbers fewer than the model's width); a open (the searches read the last position only: a under linear_bar is noted in stage0.json); a + b about 0.50 (E148's XOR2 on the plain 67M: 0.468 against 0.50 shuffled)
S0c.rule: stop if a + b's best site >= capacity_bar (no built premise); stop if b's best site < linear_bar (no positive control); a: reported, not a stop

S1a.what: alpha: per alpha in 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16 (units of E137's XOR push Q b), on 20,000 read windows, the gaps TV(F, M) of the control target, the plain target, and the taught original's target (Q b' instead of Q b)
S1a.expected: rising with alpha; E148's XOR2 gap was 0.217 at 4 and 0.258 at 6 with the same share of pushed windows (3/8), so alpha 4 or 6 expected
S1a.rule: alpha = smallest with control and plain gaps both >= gap_aim; none: the alpha with the largest smaller gap, ties to the smaller. One alpha for all three arms. Not a stop.

S1b.what: control and plain target gaps TV(F, plain 67M), mean over the read half, at the chosen alpha

T10.what: every fine-tune at step 10 (E139 Amendment 2's check, in commute.variable_read.finetune)
T10.expected: KL(F||ft) below KL(F||M) and KL(M||ft) at most KL(M||F), M the fine-tune's own original
T10.rule: an arm fine-tune that misses stops the job; the taught original that misses drops the taught arm

L.what: learned check per arm fine-tune: KL(F || ft) / KL(F || original + push/2) on 4,096 keyed windows of held-out pairs (commute.variable_read.learned_ratio)
L.expected: control under 0.2 (E148's harder XOR2 plain fine-tune read 0.15 at 300 steps); plain under 0.9, open; taught under 0.5
L.rule: learned if ratio <= learned_kl_ratio. Seed 0: 300 steps, else 3000 from the original again; seed 1 on seed 0's rung. Not learned: no reading (seed 0 without a reading ends the arm: 'no call')

S2a.what: the taught original: the 67M fine-tuned toward 67M + alpha Q b' on the sum's bit (Q b' a seeded direction of E137's pieces' span orthogonal to Q b, same length: the same skill with other answers), 300 steps, else 3000; gate: capacity read of a + b's parity on held-out pairs, best site
S2a.expected: open; E148's taught original (a third of the push, 300 steps) read 0.588; S0b predicts this gate
S2a.rule: the taught arm runs only if the best site >= linear_bar at one rung; otherwise it is dropped and reported as dropped; the control and plain arms still run and are read

S2b.what: the taught arm's target gap TV(taught + alpha Q b on a + b odd, taught original), mean over the read half; then the zero-step control on the taught original
S2b.expected: about the plain arm's gap (0.22 to 0.26): the target is set from the taught original itself, so its own drift is not part of the gap (E148's lesson); zero-step as S0a
S2b.rule: gap not above target_gap_min drops the taught arm; zero-step as S0a, a stop

P2.claim: Plain arm (plain 67M, bit a + b odd; seeds 0 and 1): best found H below 0.5 on both seeds, expected under 0.25 (Fable; E148's plain XOR2 arm read 0.08, 0.09); G (seed 0) under 0.25 (E148 0.10); label 'no map found'

P3.rival: H below 0.5 (the search misses a variable the original holds at a linear read of at least 0.9)

P4.rival: rival b: control below on both seeds

outcome_rule.rule: Per fine-tune: a reading needs the learned check passed and gap >= floor_gap. Best found H over the five sites (in1, in2, in3, out3, final); best found G over the four sites and three starts (seed 0 only). Per arm: 'above' if both seeds have a reading with H >= cutoffs.H, 'below' if both have a reading with H < cutoffs.H, else 'no call'. Control below: rival b, the built control is uninformative, nothing further runs (job 2 and the taught original refuse). Control or plain 'no call': no call. Control above and plain above: the wording needs revising. Control above and plain below: rival a when the taught arm is above or was dropped at its gate; with the taught arm below or 'no call', rival a is not met on the second control and the reading is reported as read. Reading it as 'built' stays a rule only the user adds. Per seed-0 fine-tune: label by item_label with cutoffs G and H; a seed-1 fine-tune at or above 0.5 has no label (G not read). Computed by experiments/built_control_sum/plot.py (readings.json).
outcome_rule.edge_cases: A value exactly at a cut-off or bar counts as at or above it (item_label's convention): H 0.5 is above; a capacity read of exactly 0.9 passes linear_bar; a sum read of exactly 0.55 stops; gaps must be strictly above 0.15. One seed without a reading makes its arm 'no call', never 'below': a fine-tune that learned nothing cannot pass as built. Seed 0 without a reading ends the arm (seed 1 and G not run): 'no call'. A dropped taught arm reads nothing and does not block rival a (the card makes the taught arm conditional on its gate). The do-nothing fine-tune has gap 0 < floor_gap and a learned ratio KL(F||M)/KL(F||M+push/2) of about 2 (E139's XOR read 0.0778 / 0.0369 = 2.1, xor_s0.json; E148's plain 1.246 / 0.777 = 1.6), so it reads 'no reading' and can reach neither side; the zero-step control checks the first. learned_ratio's denominator is positive for any nonzero push (asserted). A missing G (seed 1) never changes a side, which reads H only. Ties in choosing alpha go to the smaller alpha. A wall-limit exit (3) resumes from the saved files and changes no rule.
outcome_rule.blind_to: H and G read only the fine-tune's outputs on D's windows: a fine-tune that matches F exactly reads F's values whatever is inside it. The capacity reads are linear: they cannot see a nonlinear code of the sum's parity in the plain 67M, nor a nonlinear one in the taught original (which then misses its gate). Every search and read takes the last position only: an operand's bit held only at its own position is invisible to them (S0c reports a's). G on seed 1 and the G sites cut under the 3000-step rung are not read.

noise_floor: Seed-to-seed sd of best found H across E139's three Always on fine-tunes: 0.028 (0.505, 0.450, 0.483; experiments/reuse_variable_finetune/results/always_on_s*.json); Table's 0.005. E148's two plain seeds differed by 0.01, its two taught seeds by under 0.01. One start's G spread at the best site in E137: 0.113 pooled.
positive_control: The control arm (b odd on the plain 67M), first: the same search on the same windows, push and alpha, where the original holds the bit as a linear read (S0c checks it). The taught arm is the second, when it passes its gate.
stop: The control below 0.5 on both seeds: the search cannot certify reuse on this layout, the built control is reported as uninformative and nothing further runs. Control above and plain above: the wording needs revising (card).
